analysis.configuredCodes: Some components used codes configured by an administrator because the questionnaire shipped no value labels.
analysis.foodNote: An average of the declared shares across the units shown, weighted by household numbers. Withheld cells are left out of the average, not counted as zero.
analysis.readinessNote: A weighted score out of 100 built from water, shelter, electricity and household size. Components that cannot be resolved are withheld and named.
analysis.suppressionNote: Cells covering too few households are withheld so nobody can be identified. The threshold is a setting, not hard coded.
